title: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: An Agency detective who frees Etrata and investigates her missing time, discovering strange yellow-gray powder in her hideout.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir vampire assassin who cooperates with Proft to clear her name.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A Rakdos assassin with a painted red grin hired to kill the man who caught Etrata.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker leading the Agency's investigation who visits Vitu-Ghazi to read the Guildpact.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A cheerful young Agency investigator who wields woven-basket elemental swords and accompanies Kaya.

entities.name: Tolsimir
entities.description: An elf of the Selesnya Conclave who accompanies the wolf Voja and escorts Kaya to the Guildpact.

entities.name: Voja
entities.description: A massive white wolf Kaya knows, loyal to Tolsimir.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The three-bodied dryad through whom the Worldsoul of Ravnica speaks, who receives Kaya in Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Ses
entities.description: The dryad of order, the rightmost body of Trostani.

entities.name: Cim
entities.description: The dryad of harmony, the left body of Trostani.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The dryad of life, now the central body of Trostani, who rebukes Kaya for being absent.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The Selesnya voice who told Trostani that Vitu-Ghazi needed space to recover.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A demon bound by the Guildpact to the Cult of Rakdos to channel his murderous influence.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: The Rakdos figure who directed Kaya to the Guildpact.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: The murdered Simic leader.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The Orzhov leader whose death is already spreading as news.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: The Agency head to whom Kaya must report.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya living guildhall, now reconfigured as a manor wrapped in roots on a remote moor.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: A district where Kellan says his friend went to explore a ruin.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city-plane.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The founding contract of the guilds, kept in book form in Vitu-Ghazi, whose Rakdos section reveals the demon's murderous influence.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: The living soul of Ravnica that speaks through Trostani.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild that holds Vitu-Ghazi and the surrounding park.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The guild bound to placate the demon Rakdos.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The spy guild that protects its territory and does not sanction unauthorized hits.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The law guild from whose custody Etrata was freed.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild of Kaya and Teysa.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: The independent investigative body Proft and Kellan belong to.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who damaged Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: God-Eternals
entities.description: The Phyrexian-aligned beings who deeply damaged Vitu-Ghazi.

events.summary: Etrata leads Proft along a Dimir street and opens a concealed entrance to her hideout.
events.quote: With a weary grinding sound, a section of the wall slightly smaller than an ordinary door shifted and slid inward

events.summary: Etrata says she remembers nothing of the party or of getting ready for it.
events.quote: I don't remember going to that party, much less getting ready for it

events.summary: Proft explains he is helping her because her case is the most interesting puzzle since the invasion.
events.quote: Right now, you represent the most interesting puzzle set before me since the invasion.

events.summary: Proft finds a fine yellow-gray powder on Etrata's bedside table and pillow.
events.quote: There, dusted across the wood and onto the nearby pillowcase, was a fine yellowish-gray powder.

events.summary: Proft scrapes the powder into a jar for evidence.
events.quote: he scraped as much of it as he could into the open jar before sealing it firmly.

events.summary: Etrata decides to defend Proft against an attacker in the hall.
events.quote: With a frustrated sigh, Etrata turned, pulling two more knives from inside her shirt, and leapt for the fight behind her.

events.summary: A figure in red and black attacks Proft; Etrata knocks her away and recognizes Massacre Girl.
events.quote: Proft was on the ground, a figure dressed in red and black crouching over him, a knife in either hand.

events.summary: Massacre Girl reveals she was hired to kill the man who caught Etrata.
events.quote: I was supposed to kill the man who caught you.

events.summary: Etrata claims Proft and says they are finding out who really killed Zegana; Massacre Girl stands down.
events.quote: I'm helping him find out who really killed Zegana.

events.summary: Massacre Girl leaves, promising there is always next time.
events.quote: There's always next time.

events.summary: Proft says he will take Etrata to an old friend not associated with the Agency.
events.quote: To see an old friend of mine

events.summary: Kaya recalls Vitu-Ghazi's dormancy after the God-Eternals' damage and sets out with Kellan.
events.quote: When last Kaya had seen Vitu-Ghazi, the great living guildhall had been dormant

events.summary: A carriage driver reproaches Kaya for being absent during the Phyrexian invasion.
events.quote: And you could have been here when the Phyrexians came.

events.summary: Kellan reveals a friend came with him to Ravnica and is exploring the Rubblebelt.
events.quote: A friend of my own came with me.

events.summary: Kellan explains that Vitu-Ghazi was moved to the moor to recover after the invasion.
events.quote: Mat'Selesnya told Trostani that Vitu-Ghazi needed space to put down new root structures

events.summary: A massive white wolf charges Kaya and Kellan.
events.quote: A massive white wolf was loping toward them

events.summary: Kaya identifies the wolf as Voja and tells Kellan to defend only.
events.quote: His name is Voja.

events.summary: Tolsimir arrives and Kaya explains they are investigating Zegana's death.
events.quote: Inspector Kellan and I are investigating the matter of Zegana's death

events.summary: Tolsimir hints that another guild leader has been harmed and tells Kaya to look within her own guild.
events.quote: you might look within your own guild, Planeswalker Kaya.

events.summary: Kaya sees Vitu-Ghazi's new form as a manor wrapped in roots.
events.quote: The towering guildhall had reconfigured itself as it came to rest in the open moor.

events.summary: Trostani appears as three dryads from the oak and agrees to let Kaya consult the Guildpact.
events.quote: Three dryads, each one an individual, and collectively the singular entity through which the Worldsoul of Ravnica was said to speak.

events.summary: Oba rebukes Kaya, noting deaths occurred while she was gone.
events.quote: Like all the deaths while you were gone?

events.summary: Tolsimir lowers a protective bubble so Kaya and Kellan can read the original Guildpact.
events.quote: A bubble of magical force surrounded an open book.

events.summary: Kaya reads that the founders bound the demon Rakdos to a people to contain his murderous influence over Ravnica.
events.quote: by binding the demon Rakdos to a people of his own, we can prevent his continuing to instill murderous rage in the citizens of Ravnica

events.summary: Kaya connects Etrata's missing memory to Rakdos's influence and resolves to report to Ezrim.
events.quote: We need to report this to Ezrim as soon as possible.
